t: You're looking at the Russian Orthodox Cathedral of the Dormition of the Mother of God and All Saints. It serves as the cathedral of the Russian Orthodox Diocese of Sourozh. The building was designed by Lewis Vulliamy, an English architect who came from the Vulliamy family of clockmakers. That's a nice detail to hold onto as you look at it: an architect whose family name was tied to the making of clocks, here shaping a place of worship.
